arcChoices.title: Yoruba Traditions
arcChoices.description: Eight weeks on Yoruba sources, stories, and regional variation.

topic.yoruba-survey-and-legends.title: Ellis’s survey and Ogumefu’s legends
topic.yoruba-survey-and-legends.body: Two Yoruba-specific sources with different authority: Ellis’s 1894 colonial-era ethnographic report and Ogumefu’s 1929 Yoruba-authored legend collection. Claims stay attached to whichever book actually supports them.

cards.title: Who wrote it?
cards.body: Ellis was a British colonial officer reporting in 1894; Ogumefu was a Yoruba author collecting legends in 1929.

cards.title: A living tradition
cards.body: Yoruba religion is practised today in West Africa and the diaspora; these nineteenth- and early-twentieth-century books are windows, not the whole tradition.
